metadata.description: Kortalan Forma Studio's sculptural forms blur the line between Furniture and Collectible Design. Works range from dining and coffee tables to chairs and lighting.
metadata.title: Index | Kortalan Forma / Collectible Furniture and Objects

productData.description: Crafted from 4 interlocking volumes, the angled geometry and low profile of the M_007 Lounge Chair delicately emphasize the spacing between its joints. Its inviting sculptural form balances it’s powerful profile and beckons you to sit.

Carved from a single stone, the soft curves, and powerful stature of the M_001 Chair offer a grounded almost ritualistic presence. Its simple and subtly refined geometry beckon you to sit upon its throne like form. Suitable for indoor/outdoor use.

Crafted from 4 interlocking volumes, the angled geometry and low profile of the M_007 Lounge Chair delicately emphasize the spacing between its joints. Its inviting sculptural form balances it’s powerful profile and beckons you to sit.

Carved with precision, the M_002 Side Table balances between architectural strength and sculptural form. Its strong geometric lines cradle a half-dome sphere which floats effortlessly within its base evoking a sense of quiet elegance.
productData.designedBy: Studio Le Cann for Kortalan Forma

productData.description: Cut from a single stone, the prehistoric form of the M_004 Lamp blurs the line between tool and object. Its warm glow shines softly through its commanding form powered by a dimmable 2,700K led hidden elegantly within its base.

Sculpted with bold curvature, the M_013 Dining Chair merges soft volumes with a stark, intersecting silhouette. The striking form, defined by its low T-shaped backrest, is both solid and airy, using negative space to create a dynamic interplay of balance and support.

Crafted from 3 precisely carved blocks, the curved figure of the M_005 Bench emphasizes the connection between its parts. Its soft curves playfully bend the structure, its engineering reflecting the architectural elegance of a simple bridge. Suitable for indoor / outdoor use. 
Customization available upon request.

navigationDrawerContent.description: Kortalan Forma is a design studio and gallery featuring a collection of monolithic furniture and objects. Each minimalist piece uses purity of lines and heavy proportions to reveal the natural beauty and sophistication of each material.
